title: Amendment: the nested 500-item subsample rule
description:
Write a preregistration amendment in docs/kev-amendments.md (and note it in the Jev and Laya plans) that fixes the subsample **before any subsampled answer is collected**.

- Per cell, rank the items by sha256(seed + item id) and take the first 500 items (an item is an original with its twin, or a control with its edit). Controls and cells of 1,000 requests or fewer run in full.
- Nested: the first N is contained in the first 2N, so growing the sample later only adds items.
- Identical for Jev, Laya and Kev. Never based on any answer.
- Every result is reported as partial with its sample size.

Done when the amendment is committed to main and states the seed and the cap.
